item.description: Source: The Hechinger Report — For years, the debate about artificial intelligence and jobs has understandably focused on which workers machines will replace. People are worried about job security, and employers are seeking efficiencies. Yet as AI-supported tasks and outputs become increasingly commonplace in virtually every workplace, the conversation is shifting.
